title: Eddie Excavator's Rain-Garden Day | Construction Story-Song for Kids
format: original musical construction story with melodic rhythmic character-led delivery

music.sound_policy: Machine, soil, rain, stone, planting and water sounds are performed as synchronized effects and never spoken as imitation words.

creative_intent: Turn safe rain-garden construction into a warm musical cause-and-effect story in which concern becomes confidence, care, suspense and shared delight.

scenes.visual_action: Rainwater runs from the downpipe into a muddy low spot. Eddie studies the rain-garden plan while two children and a grown-up remain behind the orange safety fence.
scenes.musical_treatment: Soft marimba droplets, low pizzicato strings and a questioning two-note melody; percussion enters when Eddie looks from the plan to the basin.
lyrics: Rain is drawing rivers where the muddy puddles grow,
Eddie reads the garden plan and finds where they should flow.
Behind the fence we watch and wait; the working space is clear,
Eddie sings, 'We'll shape it safely—step by step from here.'
scenes.camera: slow eased push toward Eddie and the marked basin

scenes.visual_action: Eddie plants both tracks, lowers the articulated boom and curls one solid bucket through the marked soil while everyone stays outside the fence.
scenes.musical_treatment: Steady wooden pulse and bass plucks lock to the boom, dipper and bucket sequence; melody rises with the scoop.
lyrics: Tracks stay still and boom bends low,
Dipper reaches—steady, slow.
Bucket curls beneath the ground,
One careful scoop comes up, safe and sound.
scenes.camera: ground-level side tracking that clearly shows the working joints

scenes.visual_action: The loaded bucket lifts, Eddie rotates within the fenced work zone, carries the soil a short distance and tips it onto one tidy spoil pile.
scenes.musical_treatment: Rhythmic bass and brushed snare build; a rising brass phrase follows the lift and a descending phrase follows the controlled tip.
lyrics: Lift it level, hold it tight,
Turn inside the fence just right.
Carry, pause, then tip the load—
Clear the basin, shape the road.
scenes.camera: one restrained follow move matching Eddie's rotation

scenes.visual_action: Eddie uses the flat bucket edge to level the curved basin, then places rounded stones along the inlet while children point to the matching shapes from behind the fence.
scenes.musical_treatment: Bright xylophone pattern repeats in an even sequence; each stone receives a real muted stone click on the beat.
lyrics: Smooth the curve from high to low,
Make a gentle path for flow.
Round stones line the watery way—
One, two, three in a shining row today.
scenes.camera: overhead-to-oblique reveal of the complete curved basin

scenes.visual_action: Eddie is fully stopped with bucket grounded. The grown-up confirms it is safe, opens the gate and helps the children plant native grasses in the basin.
scenes.musical_treatment: Percussion softens; warm ukulele, humming harmony and lower dynamics make room for the careful planting actions.
lyrics: Engine resting, bucket down, grown-up checks the quiet ground,
Gate can open, hands come through, seedlings wait for me and you.
Press the soil, give roots their space,
Little leaves find every place.
scenes.camera: stable medium-wide composition with Eddie visibly inactive

scenes.visual_action: Everyone returns behind the fence. A gentle test flow leaves the downpipe, follows the stone inlet and slowly fills the planted basin without forming the old muddy puddle.
scenes.musical_treatment: Sparse heartbeat drum and held strings under the first water movement; harmony opens when the stream reaches the basin at the musical drop.
lyrics: Back behind the fence—we're ready for the test,
Will the little river find the garden we made best?
Past the stones and round the bend...
Into roots—our careful pathway works in the end!
scenes.camera: low follow along the water path; largest visual payoff lands at frame 2088

scenes.emotion: bright shared celebration with a warm resolve
scenes.visual_action: Sunlight breaks through. The finished rain garden glows with plants and clear water; Eddie, the children and grown-up celebrate from their safe positions as a small bird visits.
scenes.musical_treatment: Full marimba, ukulele, brass and child-friendly harmony reprise the step-by-step motif, then hold a warm final chord.
lyrics: Read the plan and make it clear,
Scoop and carry, friends stay near.
Plant with care and test the rain—
Eddie helped the garden drink again!
scenes.camera: slow pullback revealing the complete garden; settle for the final two beats

quality_gates: Every lyric and effect is contained by the scene that visibly supports it.
All seven scenes remain at or below the permanent fourteen-second story-shot ceiling.
Eddie's identity, leaf emblem, eye placement, teal stripe, bucket and realistic working joints remain consistent.
Children remain behind the safety fence whenever Eddie is operating; planting begins only after the stopped-machine check.
No machine, soil, water or bird sound is spoken as an imitation word.
The score audibly changes from concern to confidence, tenderness, suspense, relief and celebration.
Structural cuts occur on the five-bar phrase boundaries at frames 360, 720, 1080, 1440, 1800 and 2160.
Final output includes a lyric-to-visual-and-emotion audit and passes full technical decode.
